description: This is a Java source file for an Android activity named 'CheckVoiceData'. Its purpose is to verify the presence of specific voice data language files required by the text-to-speech engine, and to report the availability status back to the caller. It interacts with Android's TTS API, accesses assets, and handles intent data.

classes.name: CheckVoiceData
classes.description: An Android activity that checks for the presence of voice data files for specified languages, determining if the data is installed or missing.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, processes the intent to determine which languages to check, performs support and data availability checks, and sets the result accordingly.

methods.name: getCheckVoiceDataFor
methods.description: Extracts a list of languages to check from the intent extras.

methods.name: isLanguageSupported
methods.description: Checks whether a given language string is present in the supported languages list.

methods.name: isDataInstalled
methods.description: Determines whether voice data for a specific language is available in app assets by attempting to open the corresponding data file.
